meta.name: add-rtk
meta.description: Install rtk token-compression proxy into agent containers. Routes Bash tool calls through rtk for 60–90% token savings on dev commands (git, cargo, pytest, docker, kubectl, etc.).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在容器中安装 rtk 代理以压缩令牌，节省开发命令的令牌消耗
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 AI 辅助开发且想减少令牌消耗
copy.tagline_en: Install rtk proxy in containers to compress tokens and save on dev commands
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI-assisted development and want to reduce token usage

howto.what: 安装并启用 rtk 代理后,Claude 执行 Bash 命令时会自动经过 rtk 压缩,节省 60–90% 的 token。整个过程自动完成,无需额外指示。
howto.when: 当 Claude 在已配置的容器中运行任何 Bash 工具调用(如 git、cargo、pytest 等)时触发,该调用会被 rtk 拦截并压缩。

say.text: 运行 git status 查看当前仓库状态。
say.note: 该命令会通过 rtk 压缩 token。

say.text: 执行 pytest 并输出测试结果。
say.note: pytest 命令会经过 rtk 代理。

say.text: 运行 cargo build 检查编译是否通过。
say.note: cargo 命令会被 rtk 压缩处理。

howto.what_en: Installs the rtk token-compression proxy and routes all Bash tool calls through it, saving 60–90% of tokens on common dev commands. The setup is automatic once configured.
howto.when_en: Triggered on every Bash tool call (e.g., git, cargo, pytest) inside a configured container; the call is intercepted by rtk.

say_en.text: Run git status to see the current repository state.
say_en.note: The command will be token-compressed by rtk.

say_en.text: Run pytest and show the test results.
say_en.note: pytest commands go through the rtk proxy.

say_en.text: Run cargo build to check if compilation succeeds.
say_en.note: The cargo command will be compressed by rtk.
